title: Claim Timelines and Filing Requirements under Host Damage Protection (HostCover)
content:
Every **Host Damage Protection (HostCover)** claim runs on a set of clocks and counts fixed by the plan's level. The timetable below lists them for all six levels.

## Timetable by level

| HostCover level | Filing window after check-out (calendar days) | Guest response time (elapsed hours) | Escalation window after the guest's response deadline (calendar days) | Claims team decision on an escalated claim (business days) | Payment after approval (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| HostCover Essential | 14 | 72 | 30 | 10 | 5 |
| HostCover Standard | 14 | 72 | 30 | 10 | 5 |
| HostCover Plus | 14 | 72 | 30 | 7 | 5 |
| HostCover Premier | 14 | 72 | 30 | 5 | 5 |
| HostCover Elite | 30 | 72 | 30 | 3 | 5 |
| HostCover Estate | 30 | 72 | 30 | 3 | 5 |

## Requirements common to every level

| Requirement | Every level |
|---|---|
| The host must first request payment from the guest | Yes |
| Claims allowed per stay per damage category | 1 |
| Appeal window after a denial | 30 calendar days |
| Appeals allowed per claim | 1 |
| Evidence a claim must carry | dated photos or video of the damage and a repair estimate, invoice or receipt |

## What each clock measures

- **Filing window**: the calendar days after the stay's check-out date within which the claim must be filed.
- **Guest response time**: the elapsed hours the guest has to respond to the payment request.
- **Escalation window**: the calendar days after the guest's response deadline within which the host must escalate the claim.
- **Decision time**: the business days within which the claims team decides an escalated claim.
- **Payment time**: the business days after approval within which the reimbursement is paid.

## Questions answered by the timetable

**Does a HostCover Elite plan allow longer to file than HostCover Premier?** Yes: 30 calendar days after check-out on Elite (and Estate), against 14 on Premier and the levels below it.

**How long does the guest have to answer a payment request?** 72 elapsed hours on every level.

**How many claims can be filed for one stay?** One per damage category: a stay can carry, for instance, one theft claim and one pet-damage claim, but not two theft claims.
